meta.title: 秋冬常见面料好坏分享
meta.title_en: Winter Fabrics: How to Tell Good from Bad

scenes.context: 德绒、抓绒、摇粒绒、珊瑚绒、羊羔绒这么多绒都有什么区别？哪个更保暖、哪个更具性价比？
sentences: There are so many fleece types.
Which is warmer and better value?
paraphrase: There are so many fleece types.
Which is warmer and better value?
scenes.speak: There are so many fleece types. Which is warmer and better value?

scenes.context: 德绒保暖性堪比羊绒，因为纤维之间能储存空气；但真正的德绒早已停产，市面上的都是沿用概念。
sentences: Real Decron stopped production long ago.
paraphrase: Real Decron stopped production long ago.
scenes.speak: Decron traps air for warmth. Real Decron stopped production long ago.

scenes.context: 停产截图配样片特写，主讲人判定市面上的德绒只是概念复用，国内多用精润代替。
sentences: The notice screenshot is the proof.
paraphrase: The notice screenshot is the proof.
scenes.speak: The notice screenshot is the proof. Concept recycling isn't real Decron.

scenes.context: 抓绒、摇粒绒、珊瑚绒其实就是一样的东西，只是表面绒毛长短不同，像饮料的小杯中杯大杯。
sentences: The three fleeces are the same thing.
paraphrase: The three fleeces are the same thing.
scenes.speak: The three fleeces are the same thing. Only the pile length differs.

scenes.context: 抓绒毛短多用于内衣，摇粒绒是长抓绒面料放进机器摇出颗粒感，多用于外套或内胆。
sentences: Fleece gets its pebbly feel from tumbling.
paraphrase: Fleece gets its pebbly feel from tumbling.
scenes.speak: Short-pile sherpa lines underwear. Fleece gets its pebbly feel from tumbling.

scenes.context: 珊瑚绒毛细长特别柔软做睡衣；羊羔绒全名仿羊羔绒，是环保平绒毛衣常用的替代品。
sentences: Coral fleece is soft for pajamas.
paraphrase: Coral fleece is soft for pajamas.
scenes.speak: Coral fleece is soft for pajamas. Lambswool fleece is usually faux.

scenes.context: 这些绒保暖好但都是化纤产品，极易产生静电，一定要选带导电丝或防静电处理的。
scenes.speak: Synthetic fleece builds static easily. Choose anti-static treatments.

scenes.context: 有个品牌在抓绒界独树一帜，因为它是抓绒鼻祖，带标的都贵；现在优衣库、迪卡侬等平替很多。
sentences: The pioneer brand charges a premium.
paraphrase: The pioneer brand charges a premium.
scenes.speak: The pioneer brand charges a premium. Budget alternatives keep growing.

practice: The three fleeces are the same thing.
pitfalls: 看名字以为德绒都高级
市面德绒多为概念复用
内衣选抓绒睡衣选珊瑚绒
